_notes.g.robots: A UTF-8 byte-order mark, CRLF line ends and * Disallow: /. The mark is not part of the first line, so the * group applies to all 10 retrieval crawlers: 0 and the gate cap. Before 1.5.0 the mark hid the group and this read 3.
_notes.p2.sourced-stats: The home page's route count, share and price, and the quote study's figures, are the site's own and carry no source beside them; only the pallet-price post links its source. Before 1.5.0 an outbound link or a source word anywhere on a page attributed all its figures, and this scored 5.
